name: English
title: RiftLauncher
description: RiftLauncher is an independent launcher for Vintage Story. Install multiple versions, keep separate installations with their own mods, worlds and configs, and make backups.
headline: Every version of Vintage Story, side by side.
lead: Keep as many installations as you like, each with its own mods, worlds and configs, make manual and automatic backups before anything breaks, and browse the ModDB without leaving the launcher.
beta: Beta prerelease, so expect rough edges. Back up your worlds first.
cards: Install as many game versions as you like, and choose which one each installation runs.
Every installation keeps its own mods, worlds and configs, so what you do in one leaves the others alone.
Make a backup by hand whenever you want, or have the launcher take one automatically before you play.
Browse the ModDB, install and update, search what is already installed, hold a mod back so Update all skips it, and get suggestions for an installation if you turn them on.
Manage Mods lists what will stop the game loading, such as a missing dependency, and flags a mod installed twice, each with the action that fixes it.
Save a server's address on an installation, then join it from the launcher. A modpack can carry the bookmark to whoever you share it with.
When the game closes, read a report built from its logs, with errors and warnings grouped under the mod they name, and look back at memory and CPU over your recent sessions.
Keep several Vintage Story accounts saved and switch between them.
Set the launcher's background from the catalog of scenes, or from an image of your own.
